# Muin Sound Co.

> Muin Sound Co. writes and produces original songs and soundtracks for
> weddings, themed parties, and tabletop gaming campaigns.

Muin Sound Co. is a custom music service. The homepage at
https://muinsound.co/ is the entry point and, as of this writing, the only
built page on the site — dedicated pages for weddings, parties, and
tabletop gaming are in progress and not yet published, so this file
deliberately does not link to them yet. Check https://muinsound.co/ directly
for the current state of the site.
